purpose: Rebuild and verify the expanded external corpus using the latest union-find media-content grouping. Every record linked by a stable source group, record ID or exact media-asset SHA-256 must remain in a single split across all sources. Keep Bootstrap, all synthetic curricula and locally authored records diagnostic-only; exclude them from tokenizer fitting and optimizer input. Require usable external text/tool/audio/image/video coverage and full train/validation/test disjointness, publish the corpus artifact, then automatically launch 150 steps of fresh random-initialized OneCore text/tool training on that corpus.
